tsa_passengers.title: U.S. airport passengers
tsa_passengers.description: TSA checkpoint screenings. Passenger activity; excludes cargo and does not measure fuel uplift.

europe_flights.title: European flight activity
europe_flights.description: EUROCONTROL network total, including overflights. Prior-year comparison uses the source’s matched weekday; countries must not be summed.

china_trucks.title: China highway truck traffic
china_trucks.description: Highway truck passages, not unique trucks or kilometres. Electric trucks and changing route lengths affect the link to diesel.

china_flights.title: China flight activity
china_flights.description: Civil aviation flights reported by the transport ministry. Weekly totals include cargo flights.
